reviews.text: Of all the veterinary clinics in Helsinki, this one has had the best service, price level and otherwise the place is home-themed / easy to approach. Not so institutional.. easy to take the animal to be treated. We still have a big and challenging dog, but Oskar (I think) did a great job and for that a big thank you.
Friendly and good service.

I went with my female dog for a hernia check-up first and it was decided to operate..
I got an appointment quickly. The very next day I took my girl for hernia surgery and at the same time she was sterilized. Everything went great. Thanks to the entire staff.

On my sister's recommendation, I went to this veterinary clinic with my cat, which I bitterly regretted visiting afterwards. When I made the appointment, I told her on the phone that the cat was aggressive (fear-aggressive) towards strangers and that it could not tolerate being touched by strangers, so it definitely needed to be calmed down before being examined. When we went to the doctor's room, I put the carrying cage on the table they showed me. There was no discussion or question about the cat, they just told me to open the cage door and take the cat out. The doctor immediately started examining my cat without any protective equipment, even though I told him that the cat was aggressive when touched by strangers. When I then wondered aloud about the cat's calmness while the doctor examined it, the doctor said that it was just frozen in fear. Still, no sedation was given. Suddenly, the cat started to throw up and ran along the walls, tables and cabinets, and the doctor's hands were bleeding in the commotion. Then the cat backed into a corner and the doctor slammed the carrying case hard at the cat and trapped it in the case. The cat must have been hurt and the cat was immediately thrown from the case into a cage. At that point, I was ordered out of the room. I was so shocked by such extremely barbaric, unprofessional behavior that I couldn't say a word. For the next six months or so, the cat just hissed, scratched, bit and attacked whenever I moved. I had to protect myself with felt, bath towels, cardboard sheets, etc. against these truly ferocious attacks. The cat, who had previously been purring, wanting company, curious and involved in everything, turned into an aggressive, hissing little beast. The situation got so bad that I had to think about putting it down. It was a really traumatic visit to the doctor for both the cat and me.

I would give 0 stars if I could.
From my experience for many years, but it was the last time and I definitely do not recommend this place to anyone else.

A healthy cat was brought in for routine tartar removal. The cat went home after the procedure and was diagnosed with blindness. It was taken to a veterinarian specializing in eyes who stated that the blood pressure had not been properly monitored during the procedure and that it had increased the pressure in the brain so much that the retinas had torn off. The result was irreversible blindness. The cat lived for a few days after the procedure until it suddenly became really bad and was rushed to the Viikki emergency room where they ended up with emergency euthanasia. It was determined that the procedure had likely caused a brain hemorrhage.

I definitely recommend Herttaa from this place.

The blood test results showed the reality, meaning our beloved pet was allowed to stay with us for one extra day, but we 100% recommend Sopulitie and especially Eve!

Why is A.R. allowed to be a doctor at this clinic? He has caused so much grief and loss, even reading these reviews gives the impression that he is an unprofessional person. I have nightmares about this person and what he did to my beloved family member.

The veterinarian was so nice and knowledgeable. Mrs. Amiraali is very timid and sensitive, but the health check and vaccination were successful quickly! Yes, it was a cozy place and wonderful staff. We will come again! Highly recommend this place and Eve Tara-Vahde! ❤️

The visit to this veterinary clinic was a very worrying experience.

My pet was in bad shape and in my opinion the IV was completely inadequate for only a few seconds.

Before taking blood tests, the vet said that my pet's "kidney values ​​will probably spike," but the treatment was still not started properly, even though the vet talked about starting hydration.

The caps of the medicine syringes just flew to the floor and the doctor threw the trash in the reception room far away, where they didn't even end up, but ended up directly on the floor.

While we were waiting for the results of the blood tests, my pet was not kept on the IV, even though the doctor said that they would look at more hydration and mentioned that my pet's condition was serious.

When I raised the issue of how the hydration situation was and that blood had been taken from the pet, I didn't get a clear answer to the situation and the vet just scratched his head and said that not much blood was even taken.

When I announced that I was taking my cat elsewhere for treatment, the situation felt even more confusing and unprofessional. At that time, he gave us medicine and told us nothing other than, "This will not cure the pet."

The payment policy was also unclear, as the payment was directed to the veterinarian's own company and not to the veterinary clinic, and this was not told in advance, which is suspicious.

Overall, the experience left me with a lack of confidence in the quality of care and communication. I cannot recommend it, the experience was scary and inappropriate.
It's not worth taking your pet here. They euthanized my cat in a really shocking way, didn't give enough medicine first and watched my cat suffer in its final moments. They didn't even apologize

We went here with 3 cats at first, then 2 and now only one. We switched here from Malmin Apex Elli due to recommendations. The service there was quite good but the prices skyrocketed and we couldn't afford to use three seniors at Elli when needed. I didn't want to compromise on anyone's kitty's care. This has been a good place and the staff have been nice. Sometimes someone is rude but not all of them are super customer service people, although they haven't been rude. 2 female senior cats were taken and left in the cold waiting for their final resting place. Hesyn will be buried in the ground as long as the weather permits. Sonja has been our veterinarian the whole time and I wouldn't change. We go with our 19 year old senior boy cat once a month for a pain shot and every couple of months for a couple of check-ups. I have always received information about the cats' treatments and results without asking. At least Sonja treats cats well and professionally and skillfully. Nothing is done to a fur baby if the owner doesn't want it. The proposed treatments were always well justified and explained more if the owner did not understand what was explained properly. I cannot recommend it for dental operations. In November/-24, Sopulitie said that there were no teeth that could be extracted and only incipient periodontitis. When the dog started showing symptoms and I took it to another vet, there were 6 teeth that could be extracted and bad bone loss and abscesses. Hopefully, in the future, Sopuli will do dental check-ups and every customer will get, among other things, a dental chart. Otherwise, I ask, why are procedures being performed that they may not yet have the skills for?

We used the dogs for tartar removal and oral x-rays in 2/2025. One dog was diagnosed with 1 tooth extraction, which was removed at the same time. And the other dog should have had 7 teeth removed. However, the dog was not treated other than having the tartar removed and being asked to return in 2 months. Both dogs were really sick after anesthesia and vomited for 3 days. The dog whose teeth were not yet removed had severe symptoms with its mouth after the procedure. We decided to take him to another facility 3 weeks after the first procedure. In reality, the dog had to have 12 teeth removed and there were many teeth in its mouth that were almost loose and one tooth fell out during the oral examination and it became very rotten. The back teeth had not been cleaned at all either, as a result of which the gums were screamingly red and inflamed. The dog's mouth must not have been looked into at all, as such things should have been noticed and treated immediately. The dog experienced shocking suffering. The vet at the second clinic also said that the x-rays were poorly taken and that not all the teeth had even been photographed. I also sent the first dog's x-rays to another doctor because I suspected that he still had bad teeth left in his mouth, and the doctor at the second clinic said that the images were again incomplete and that several teeth needed to be extracted.
